scope: Native INIT rate reducer at 44.1 kHz, ordinary build flags in a Linux host process. Static rate controls, a mid-note edit, original LFO assignment off. Both arms receive the same shipping six-voice INIT dry signal. This compares one effect stage; no complete factory- or board-level result.

negative_control.implementation: Directly divide sample rate by edited rate, omitting the original log2/exp2 intermediate rounding

stdout: 128 control sweeps, 14976 frames per sweep, 0 failures
